scenarios.title: One trial, two sites
scenarios.description: Four matching site rows represent three trials. Summing joined rows counts T1 twice; numeric DISTINCT erases one of the equal rates.

sql.joined_rows: SELECT t.id,t.enrollment,t.rate,s.id AS site_id,NULL AS intervention_id FROM trial t JOIN site s ON s.trial_id=t.id WHERE s.country=:country ORDER BY t.id,site_id,intervention_id
sql.incorrect_aggregate: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS trial_count, SUM(t.enrollment) AS enrollment_sum, SUM(DISTINCT t.enrollment) AS misleading_distinct_sum FROM trial t JOIN site s ON s.trial_id=t.id WHERE s.country=:country
sql.incorrect_rates: SELECT DISTINCT t.rate FROM trial t JOIN site s ON s.trial_id=t.id WHERE s.country=:country AND t.rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.rate
sql.corrected_cohort: SELECT t.id,t.enrollment,t.rate FROM trial t WHERE t.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT t.id FROM trial t JOIN site s ON s.trial_id=t.id WHERE s.country=:country) ORDER BY t.id
sql.corrected_aggregate: WITH cohort AS (SELECT t.id,t.enrollment,t.rate FROM trial t WHERE t.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT t.id FROM trial t JOIN site s ON s.trial_id=t.id WHERE s.country=:country) ORDER BY t.id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS trial_count,SUM(enrollment) AS enrollment_sum FROM cohort
sql.geographic_pairs: WITH cohort AS (SELECT t.id,t.enrollment,t.rate FROM trial t WHERE t.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT t.id FROM trial t JOIN site s ON s.trial_id=t.id WHERE s.country=:country) ORDER BY t.id), pairs AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.id,s.country,c.enrollment FROM cohort c JOIN site s ON s.trial_id=c.id WHERE s.country IS NOT NULL AND s.country=:country) SELECT country,COUNT(*) AS trial_count,COUNT(enrollment) AS known_enrollment_n,SUM(enrollment) AS trial_enrollment_sum FROM pairs GROUP BY country ORDER BY country
sql.incorrect_geography: SELECT s.country,COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS trial_count,COUNT(t.enrollment) AS known_enrollment_row_n,SUM(t.enrollment) AS trial_enrollment_sum FROM trial t JOIN site s ON s.trial_id=t.id WHERE s.country IS NOT NULL AND s.country=:country GROUP BY s.country ORDER BY s.country
